normalization: post-layernorm after each residual addition, with learned affine gain and bias
embedding_layout: embed has 66 rows: the first 3 are position embeddings, followed by 63 token embeddings; each input representation is the sum of its position and token embedding
matrix_convention: row vectors: x @ W + b; each pair of .0/.1 tensors is a weight matrix and bias; ln tensors are gain and bias
attention: scaled dot-product attention with softmax over positions, concatenated heads, then output projection
output_projection: final maps the last block's hidden state to class logits; no additional output bias
